description.value:
Slot none; Price 10,000 gp (lesser), 20,000 gp (normal), 40,000 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 2 sp

The acid or fire effects of the affected talent adhere to the affected creature(s), causing more damage the next round. When a creature takes acid or fire damage from the affected talent, that creature takes damage equal to the talent’s caster level at the start of its next turn. The damage is acid or fire, as determined by the spell’s descriptor. If a burning talent has both the fire and acid descriptor, the caster chooses what kind of damage is dealt by the burning talent effect.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Burning Spell; Cost 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Use as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect while holding this apparatus in at least one hand. Spend one of its three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. The apparatus does not require knowing its feat or paying that feat’s extra spell points/casting time. Normal sphere-effect costs and other known metamagic costs still apply. The chosen sphere effect must be caster level 7 or lower.

Only acid/fire damage triggers a next-turn rider equal to the sphere talent’s caster level. Choose acid or fire if both descriptors apply; do not repeat all original damage dice.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. The Feat Cost in the source applies to taking the feat instead of using the physical item.
